description: This file implements an LLM Guard integration for content moderation in a proxy setting. It defines a class `_ENTERPRISE_LLMGuard` that manages content moderation checks by making HTTP requests to an external API, and provides methods for synchronous and asynchronous moderation workflows, including pre-call hooks and streaming hooks.

classes.name: _ENTERPRISE_LLMGuard
classes.description: A custom logger class that manages content moderation via an external LLM Guard API, providing methods for moderation checks and hooks for use in API request handling.

methods.name: __init__( self, mock_testing: bool = False, mock_redacted_text: Optional[dict] = None, )
methods.description: Initializes the LLM Guard instance, setting up API base URL and optional testing parameters.

methods.name: moderation_check(self, text: str)
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous moderation check on provided text by calling the external API.

methods.name: bool should_proceed(self, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, data: dict)
methods.description: Determines whether to proceed with moderation based on mode and user permissions.

methods.name: async_moderation_hook( self, data: dict, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, call_type: CallTypesLiteral, )
methods.description: Pre-call hook that formats prompt, checks moderation, and potentially blocks or sanitizes requests.

methods.name: async_post_call_streaming_hook( self, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, response: str )
methods.description: Checks response content after a call for moderation.
